description: Manage forum spaces and moderation in OpenVibe.Space: create spaces, update settings and categories, manage moderators, and gate spaces to creator VIP members. Service callers need space.forum.manage; people need discussion staff or a space moderator where supported. PUT /api/v1/spaces/:space/moderators/:subject refuses a block in either direction with 403 space.blocked (errors.problem@1). Other Space problem codes are documented in docs/space-problem-codes.md.
